resources.string: Follow these guidelines to ensure a safe and successful transaction on FairSwap.
NEVER enter your UPI PIN to receive money. Scammers may send QR codes or payment links claiming they are sending you money. You only need a PIN to send money, not to receive it.
Do not pay advance fees for items you haven\'t seen. Be wary of sellers asking for booking amounts, fake courier charges, or shipping fees upfront.
Always arrange to meet in a safe, well-lit, and public place. If possible, bring a friend. Inspect the item thoroughly before completing any payment.
Scammers may impersonate armed forces personnel or officials to build false trust. Always verify the item in person, regardless of the seller\'s claimed identity.

If you encounter a suspicious listing or user on FairSwap, use the \'Report\' button on the listing or their profile. If you have been a victim of cyber fraud in India, immediately contact the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal or helpline at 1930.
